task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a standalone OpenQASM 3 program preparing an 5-qubit GHZ state with measurement, plus Python code that loads it with qiskit.qasm3 and samples 1000 shots. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
